newsitem.title: UK: IPE trade rises 4 pct to 15.5 mln contracts in 199.
newsitem.headline: IPE trade rises 4 pct to 15.5 mln contracts in 199.

text.p: London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) traded a record 15.5 million contracts in 1996, a rise of 4 percent on the previous year, the exchange said in a statement on Thursday.
It was the 11th year-on-year increase at the IPE, unparelleled by any other futures or options exchange in the world, it said.
Oil prices rose to six year highs in 1996 and volatility was the highest since the Gulf War in 1991 due largely to uncertainty surrounding the resumption of Iraqi crude oil exports and low stocks.

Lynton Jones, the IPE's Chief Executive said "The high level of oil price volatility that has been seen over the past 12 months highlights the industry's growing need for effective price risk management and trading tools."
